Marie L.: Heads-up — we start code freeze for RC tomorrow at 17:00 UTC; freeze in ~45m. If you need a late merge, post PR, owner, short risk note and changelog entry. I'll triage.
aj: PR #5678 — small patch: package.json version bump for @redwood/inference-sdk. No behavior change. CI green on my branch. Request exception.
sam: @aj who owns the changelog entry for this RC?
aj: I'll add a one-liner under docs/changelog/rc-2026.md. Cherry-pick command for release branch:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout release/rc && git cherry-pick -x abc1234
```
ci-bot: CI — build 5678: 248 passed, 3 flaky tests (rerun advised) — https://ci.example/5678
sam: QA note: embedding-integration failing intermittently on main (OOM on 16k seqs) — failing step `embed_vectorize`. Suspect test resource spike.
Marie L.: That failure sounds unrelated to a SDK patch. If you can confirm a clean run on release/rc we'll allow. @devops okay with patch-only + changelog? :eyes: 
devops: devops: patch-only with changelog is acceptable. Please ensure CI green on release branch before merging. :thumbsup:
aj: Running `pytest tests/integration/embed --maxfail=1 -q` against release/rc locally; will push a run in ~10m.
sam: Re-run on release branch pls, if green we can QA approve.
Marie L.: Conditional approval — merge after I ack and CI shows green on release/rc. Last call for exceptions.
aj: ack — thanks.
ci-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks for release/rc: OK (no conflicts). 
Marie L.: Thanks team — locking branch in 30m if no further exceptions.
